اغتدين (form VIII)
# اِغْتَدَيْنَ (iḡtadayna) /iɣ.ta.daj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِغْتَدَى (iḡtadā)
# اُغْتُدِينَ (uḡtudīna) /uɣ.tu.diː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِغْتَدَى (iḡtadā)
# اِغْتَدِينَ (iḡtadīna) /iɣ.ta.diː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِغْتَدَى (iḡtadā)
